# Appar, Sundarar and Sambandar; Vedaranyam

`sam-three-saints` | Thirugnana Sambandar | 3 songs

Sambandar met Appar at Sirkazhi and Tiruvarur and travelled with him; at Vedaranyam (Thirumaraikkadu) Appar's hymn opened the temple doors and Sambandar's closed them. The songs only name the places or the three saints together; they do not narrate the doors.
